move.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH team,

You have described Hollerau as an important reference customer—it sounds like this project matters as an ongoing relationship, not just an order. We appreciate that relationship and recognise that our late payments have strained it; we will ensure reliable payment. How could faster, dependable payment and the verified reductions in material and energy indices translate into a more competitive price?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 31.50 per unit (offer:70240-0). Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -8.5% from 2024-11 to 2025-10 (idx:AS-14404@2024-11, idx:AS-14404@2025-10). We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 26.50 per unit, 14 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
